latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

title: A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act to authorize grants to States, Indian Tribes, Tribal organizations, and political subdivisions thereof to hire, employ, train, and dispatch mental health professionals to respond in lieu of law enforcement officers in emergences involving one or more persons with a mental illness or an intellectual or developmental disability, and for other purposes.
